title: THE ENEMY BECAME THE APOSTLE.
paragraphs:
The man breathing threats…
became the man breathing Scripture.

People love transformation arcs.
But this one?

This wasn’t a glow-up.
It was a death.
⚔️ The Road to Damascus — Acts of the Apostles 9

Saul wasn’t confused.
He was convinced.

Trained. Brilliant. Burning with zeal.
He thought he was protecting God.

On that desert road—dust rising, sun brutal, heart hotter than the sand—
a light split the sky.
“Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?” (Acts 9:4)
When you touch Christ’s Church, you touch Christ Himself.

Saul falls. Dust in his mouth. Pride in his throat.
Three days blind.
But Jesus says, “Go. He is a chosen instrument of Mine.” (Acts 9:15)

The terrorist becomes the testimony.
The persecutor becomes the preacher.

Water rushes over him in baptism—
cool against the fire he used to carry.

New name.
New heart.
Same intensity.
Some of you are still Saul.

You think you’re defending truth—
but you’ve never surrendered to Truth Himself.

Sin isn’t just bad behavior.
It’s rebellion against a holy God.

He didn’t find himself.
He lost himself—and found Christ.

As he would later write in Galatians 2:20,
“I have been crucified with Christ…”

Jesus lived the life Saul failed to live.
Died the death Saul deserved to die.
Rose again to offer mercy to His enemies.
Romans 5:10 says we were reconciled to God while we were enemies.
You don’t clean up and come to Jesus.

Weight loss.
Career comeback.
Reputation restored.
When the enemy becomes the apostle.

When the sinner becomes the son.
When the rebel becomes redeemed.
And if Jesus can turn a church-hunter into a church-planter—

Repent.
Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ.
Receive the mercy you’ve been running from.
